description: This file implements a translation memory system including data structures, loading, saving, and access methods for managing translation entries stored in JSON format.

classes.name: TMEntry
classes.description: Represents a translation memory entry with metadata and translation text.

classes.name: TranslationMemory
classes.description: Manages a collection of translation entries, providing loading, retrieval, addition, and persistence functionalities.

methods.name: LoadTranslationMemory
methods.description: Loads translation memory entries from a specified file path into a TranslationMemory object.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a translated entry by cache key if available and translated.

methods.name: Put
methods.description: Adds or updates a translation entry in the memory.

methods.name: Save
methods.description: Persists all translation entries to disk, ensuring data is written atomically.
